info.name: Sandbox Connect API - Direct Notebook APIs
info.description: Postman collection for the API surface active when API_BOOKINGS_ENABLED=false. Booking lifecycle, category, and slot APIs are intentionally excluded because they return 404 in this mode.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Obtains a user access token from Keycloak and saves it into the active mode environment.

request.description: Uses the Keycloak resource-owner password grant. On a 200 response, the test script saves access_token into the active Postman environment for subsequent collection requests.
Returns service health and version.
Serves the generated ReDoc API documentation UI.
Serves generated Swagger/OpenAPI JSON.
Serves generated Swagger/OpenAPI YAML.

item.name: Direct Notebook Lifecycle
item.description: Direct create/start/stop/delete operations available only when bookings are disabled.

request.description: Creates a CPU or GPU notebook when API_BOOKINGS_ENABLED=false. For GPU, instanceType is required. Empty optional runtime-asset fields are normalized away.
Starts a stopped directly managed notebook.
Stops a running directly managed notebook.
Deletes a directly managed notebook and its PVC.

item.name: Direct Notebook Token Sessions
item.description: Delegated platform-token setup and rotation for directly managed notebooks.

request.description: Exchanges the caller access token for notebook-scoped delegated tokens. A 503 is retryable while the token is being projected into the notebook.
Persists a refresh-token rotation. This request requires a delegated notebook-client access token, not the browser access token.

item.name: Booking Token Session Compatibility
item.description: The router keeps booking token-session endpoints available in direct mode for existing booked notebooks; other booking routes are disabled.

request.description: Exchanges the caller access token for notebook-scoped delegated tokens. A 503 is retryable while the token is being projected into the notebook.
Persists a refresh-token rotation. This request requires a delegated notebook-client access token, not the browser access token.

item.name: Notebook Discovery
item.description: Notebook read/status routes shared by both operating modes.

query.description: Maximum number of notebooks to return (max 50).
Optional JSON date range, for example ["2026-08-01","2026-08-31"].

request.description: Lists notebooks for the authenticated user. Enable and populate date_filter to filter by a JSON date range.
Checks whether the current user owns a non-deleted notebook with this name.
Returns the current notebook status and booking metadata when bookings are enabled.
Returns configured GPU instance types and their display metadata.

item.name: List GPU Instance Types - Legacy Alias

request.description: Backward-compatible alias for the notebook instance-types endpoint.

item.name: JupyterLite
item.description: Browser-only notebook session API shared by both operating modes.

request.description: Validates the bearer token, sets the HttpOnly JupyterLite authentication cookie, and returns the launch URL.
Creates the authenticated user's Kubeflow Profile and workspace PVC, or succeeds if they already exist.
